does not manufacture or supply hardware like continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, or remote patient monitoring systems

Wearable Health Technologies
Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs):
Devices like Dexcom or Abbott Freestyle Libre track blood sugar levels day and night.
Smartwatches & Wearables:
Devices from Apple, Samsung, or specialized brands offer heart rate and fitness tracking.
Wearable ECG:
Portable tools like KardiaMobile record heart electrical signals to spot rhythm issues.
Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM):
Uses connected devices (blood pressure cuffs, pulse oximeters, scales) to send vital signs directly to doctors.
